items.markdown:
No win, no fee lawyers in Perth `offer legal representation for personal injury, motor vehicle accidents, and workers' compensation claims where you pay no professional legal fees unless your case is successful`.[[1]](https://www.stephenbrowne.com.au/no-win-no-fee)[[2]](https://www.perthcitylegal.com.au/)

### How No Win, No Fee Works

- **Conditional Costs:** You sign a written agreement stating the lawyer only charges professional time if you win compensation.[[1]](https://www.eurekalawyers.com.au/no-win-no-fee)
- **Disbursements:** You may still have to pay out-of-pocket expenses—called disbursements—such as medical reports, expert witness fees, or court filing costs, even if you lose.[[1]](https://clplegal.com.au/about-us/no-win-no-fee-lawyers/)[[2]](https://www.stephenbrowne.com.au/no-win-no-fee)[[3]](https://www.eurekalawyers.com.au/no-win-no-fee)
- **No Percentage Deductions:** In Western Australia, lawyers generally charge based on time and work done rather than taking a percentage of your total settlement.[[1]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/the-firm/legal-costs/no-win-no-fee)[[2]](https://foylelegal.com/)
